profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public software company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its website, the company describes Slack AI as a tool that summarizes chats, searches files, takes meeting notes, translates conversations, and automates workflows. The company states that Slack AI operates within Slack's trusted boundary and does not use customer data to train large language models, with LLM providers having no access to customer data. Slack AI is available across all paid Slack plans globally.

Salesforce's AI products include Slack AI, embedded in its messaging platform; Tableau AI (Einstein), which provides natural language queries and CRM data integration with governance through a Trust Layer; and Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce, the company's CRM-embedded AI and agentic platform. The company indicates that Agentforce agents can run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages, allowing users to query data and trigger actions within workflow.

Salesforce reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026. The company faces law exposure in California with 208 cases registered. Six Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers are registered for Salesforce integration, including tools for SOQL queries, Salesforce administration, and DevOps pipeline management.
